name: Chun-Li
title: Strongest Woman in the World & Interpol Master
lore: Legendary martial arts master and high-ranking Interpol investigator. Chun-Li combines lightning-fast Chinese kenpo kicks, aerodynamic somersaults, and condensed spiritual Kikoken blasts to overwhelm opponents with unrelenting pressure.

moves.name: Basic Strike (5A)
moves.description: Quick forward palm thrust with sharp recovery. Ideal combo starter and poke.

moves.name: Hyakuretsukyaku (5B / Lightning Legs)
moves.description: Blistering rapid-kick flurry with golden crescent aura, shredding standing defenses.

moves.name: Spinning Bird Kick (6B)
moves.description: Inverted airborne helicopter split kick that pierces incoming projectile pressure.

moves.name: Fierce Qi Strike (5C)
moves.description: Deep horse-stance double palm strike releasing a kinetic shockwave that wallbounces.

moves.name: Air Tenshokyaku (8A)
moves.description: Snappy mid-air front kick to intercept jumping opponents.

moves.name: Air Flying Kick (8C)
moves.description: Heavy airborne downward axe kick driving opponents hard into the dirt.

moves.name: Kikoken (Special Projectile)
moves.description: Condenses 3D cyan plasma sphere between cupped hands and launches it across the arena.

moves.name: Spinning Bird Kick (Anti-Air Special)
moves.description: Upside-down spinning whirlwind kick surrounded by dynamic cyan vortex trails.

moves.name: Hoyoku-sen (Super Art Finisher)
moves.description: Chun-Li's ultimate super art. Unleashes dual-leg lightning barrages finishing in a sky-high vertical split kick.
